newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Gerry Kiely briefed on Monday and Tuesday's Farm Council to take place in Luxembourg. He said discussions would focus on the 1997/98 farm price package, olive oil reform, the calf processing premium and meat inspection negotiations with the United States.

Spokesman Peter Jorgensen briefed on the informal Environment Council to take place in Amsterdam from Friday to Sunday. He said discussions would cover the relationship between the environment, the economy and small and medium-sized enterprises.

Asked on what legal base the Commission could, if necessary, stop Boeing Co's long term exclusive sales agreements with U.S. airlines, spokesman Willy Helin answered that it would be done under the merger regulation. Helin said the agreements were unacceptable. He said the Commission had the power to say yes or no to merger cases that have been notified to its services and would exercise that power. "We will not hesitate to do so", he said.
Asked what tools could be used by the Commission to make non-EU companies implement a Commission decision, Helin said it could bring the companies to Court, impose penalties and fines.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/321: Second meeting of the joint EU-Ukraine Committee.
- IP/97/322: The Commission decides to grant ECU 298 million on financial aid to coal research projects.
- IP/97/323: Sudan: Commission approves humanitarian aid package worth ECU 11.8 million.
- IP/97/324: The Commission provides ECU 10 million to assist the town of Zwickau.
- IP/97/325: Kesko Oy fulfills Commission order to divest the daily consumer goods business of Tuko Oy.
- IP/97/326: Peru and Bolivia: Commission approves humanitarian aid worth ECU 4.2 million.
- Speech/97/88: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on "The issues as the Amsterdam Summit approaches".
- Memo/97/44: Calendar of the Commissioners' activities for the week of April 21 to 26.
- Eurostat news release No 29/97: EU industrial production up 2.0 %.
